PDF A Volumetric Approach to Rendering Microgeometry Using PRT
Abstract This paper introduces Precomputed Radiance Transfer (PRT) to shell textures in the context of rendering microgeometry. PRT is a method which allows static objects to have global illumination effects such as self shadowing and soft shadows while being rendered in real-time.
